1: // Simple Shrink Maze game targeting <canvas id="game">.
2: // Enhanced graphics: gradients, shadows, twinkling stars, and triangular enemies.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   const CONFIG = {
10:   cols: 20,
11:   rows: 20,
12:   cellSize: 30,
13:   shrinkRate: 0.02, // pixels per frame
14:   starCount: 5,
15:   enemyCount: 3,
16:   playerSpeed: 2,
17:   enemySpeed: 1,
18: };
19: 
20: // Load sound effects (tiny base64 wavs)
21: const sounds = {
22:   star: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='),
23:   lose: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='),
24:   win: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=')
25: };
26: 
27:   let scale = 1;
28:   let frame = 0;
29:   const keys = {};
30: 
31:   // generate simple maze: random walls on grid edges
32:   const maze = [];
33:   for (let y = 0; y < CONFIG.rows; y++) {
34:     const row = [];
35:     for (let x = 0; x < CONFIG.cols; x++) {
36:       // each cell may have walls on right/bottom
37:       row.push({
38:         right: Math.random() < 0.3 && x < CONFIG.cols - 1,
39:         bottom: Math.random() < 0.3 && y < CONFIG.rows - 1,
40:       });
41:     }
42:     maze.push(row);
43:   }
44: 
45:   // place player at top‑left open cell
46:   const player = { x: 0, y: 0, radius: 5 };
47: 
48:   // generate stars in random empty cells
49:   const stars = [];
50:   while (stars.length < CONFIG.starCount) {
51:     const sx = Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.cols);
52:     const sy = Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.rows);
53:     if (sx === 0 && sy === 0) continue;
54:     if (!stars.some(s => s.x === sx && s.y === sy)) {
55:       stars.push({ x: sx, y: sy, radius: 4, collected: false });
56:     }
57:   }
58: 
59:   // generate enemies with simple random walk
60:   const enemies = [];
61:   for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.enemyCount; i++) {
62:     const ex = Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.cols);
63:     const ey = Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.rows);
64:     enemies.push({ x: ex, y: ey, dir: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
65:   }
66: 
67:   // input handling
68:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
69:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
70: 
71:   function update() {
72:     // move player
73:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) player.y -= CONFIG.playerSpeed;
74:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) player.y += CONFIG.playerSpeed;
75:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.x -= CONFIG.playerSpeed;
76:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.x += CONFIG.playerSpeed;
77: 
78:     // keep player inside canvas
79:     const maxX = canvas.width / scale - CONFIG.cellSize;
80:     const maxY = canvas.height / scale - CONFIG.cellSize;
81:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.x, maxX));
82:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.y, maxY));
83: 
84:     // check star collection
85:     stars.forEach(s => {
86:       if (!s.collected && Math.hypot(player.x - s.x * CONFIG.cellSize, player.y - s.y * CONFIG.cellSize) < 10) {
87:         s.collected = true;
88:         sounds.star.play();
89:       }
90:     });
91: 
92:     // move enemies (simple random direction change)
93:     enemies.forEach(e => {
94:       if (Math.random() < 0.02) e.dir = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
95:       e.x += Math.cos(e.dir) * CONFIG.enemySpeed;
96:       e.y += Math.sin(e.dir) * CONFIG.enemySpeed;
97:       // bounce off walls
98:       if (e.x < 0 || e.x > maxX) e.dir = Math.PI - e.dir;
99:       if (e.y < 0 || e.y > maxY) e.dir = -e.dir;
100:     });
101: 
102:     // collision with enemies
103:     for (const e of enemies) {
104:       if (Math.hypot(player.x - e.x, player.y - e.y) < 10) {
105:         sounds.lose.play();
106:         alert('Game Over');
107:         reset();
108:         return;
109:       }
110:     }
111: 
112:     // shrink maze
113:     scale = Math.max(0.3, scale - CONFIG.shrinkRate / 100);
114:     if (scale <= 0.3) {
115:       sounds.win.play();
116:       alert('Too small – you survived!');
117:       reset();
118:     }
119: 
120:     // increment animation frame counter for twinkling stars
121:     frame++;
122:   }
123: 
124:   function draw() {
125:     ctx.save();
126:     // clear with background gradient
127:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
128:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e3a8a');
129:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f172a');
130:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
131:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
132:     ctx.scale(scale, scale);
133: 
134:     // shadow settings for all objects
135:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
136:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
137: 
138:     // draw maze walls with gradient stroke
139:     const wallGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, CONFIG.cols * CONFIG.cellSize, CONFIG.rows * CONFIG.cellSize);
140:     wallGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
141:     wallGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
142:     ctx.strokeStyle = wallGrad;
143:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
144:     for (let y = 0; y < CONFIG.rows; y++) {
145:       for (let x = 0; x < CONFIG.cols; x++) {
146:         const cell = maze[y][x];
147:         const px = x * CONFIG.cellSize;
148:         const py = y * CONFIG.cellSize;
149:         if (cell.right) {
150:           ctx.beginPath();
151:           ctx.moveTo(px + CONFIG.cellSize, py);
152:           ctx.lineTo(px + CONFIG.cellSize, py + CONFIG.cellSize);
153:           ctx.stroke();
154:         }
155:         if (cell.bottom) {
156:           ctx.beginPath();
157:           ctx.moveTo(px, py + CONFIG.cellSize);
158:           ctx.lineTo(px + CONFIG.cellSize, py + CONFIG.cellSize);
159:           ctx.stroke();
160:         }
161:       }
162:     }
163: 
164:     // draw twinkling stars
165:     stars.forEach((s, i) => {
166:       if (s.collected) return;
167:       const alpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(frame * 0.1 + i);
168:       ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
169:       const starGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
170:         s.x * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
171:         s.y * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
172:         0,
173:         s.x * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
174:         s.y * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
175:         s.radius
176:       );
177:       starGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffec8b');
178:       starGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b8860b');
179:       ctx.fillStyle = starGrad;
180:       ctx.beginPath();
181:       ctx.arc(s.x * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2, s.y * CONFIG.cellSize + CONFIG.cellSize / 2, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
182:       ctx.fill();
183:     });
184:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // reset
185: 
186:     // draw enemies as rotating triangles
187:     enemies.forEach(e => {
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
189:       ctx.beginPath();
190:       const cx = e.x + CONFIG.cellSize / 4;
191:       const cy = e.y + CONFIG.cellSize / 4;
192:       const size = CONFIG.cellSize / 3;
193:       ctx.moveTo(
194:         cx + size * Math.cos(e.dir),
195:         cy + size * Math.sin(e.dir)
196:       );
197:       ctx.lineTo(
198:         cx + size * Math.cos(e.dir + Math.PI * 0.8),
199:         cy + size * Math.sin(e.dir + Math.PI * 0.8)
200:       );
201:       ctx.lineTo(
202:         cx + size * Math.cos(e.dir - Math.PI * 0.8),
203:         cy + size * Math.sin(e.dir - Math.PI * 0.8)
204:       );
205:       ctx.closePath();
206:       ctx.fill();
207:     });
208: 
209:     // draw player with radial gradient
210:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
211:       player.x + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
212:       player.y + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
213:       0,
214:       player.x + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
215:       player.y + CONFIG.cellSize / 2,
216:       player.radius * 2
217:     );
218:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4f46e5');
219:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1e40af');
220:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
221:     ctx.beginPath();
222:     ctx.arc(player.x + CONFIG.cellSize / 2, player.y + CONFIG.cellSize / 2, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
223:     ctx.fill();
224: 
225:     ctx.restore();
226:   }
227: 
228:   function loop() {
229:     update();
230:     draw();
231:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
232:   }
233: 
234:   function reset() {
235:     // simple reset: reload page
236:     location.reload();
237:   }
238: 
239:   // set canvas size if not defined
240:   if (!canvas.width) canvas.width = CONFIG.cols * CONFIG.cellSize;
241:   if (!canvas.height) canvas.height = CONFIG.rows * CONFIG.cellSize;
242: 
243:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
244: })();

(End of file - total 244 lines)
</content>
